# Hillcrest Dehradun

> Luxury hilltop villa community by Urban Estates, Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India.

## Project Summary

- Name: Hillcrest Dehradun
- Developer: Urban Estates
- Type: Luxury residential villa community (gated society)
- Location: Khurawa, Sahastradhara Road, Dehradun, Uttarakhand 248013
- Approval: MDDA (Mussoorie Dehradun Development Authority) approved
- Configuration: 4 BHK + Study Room, fully furnished
- Total villas: 15 exclusive residences
- Starting price: ₹5.5 crore
- Status: All 15 villas sold out
- Established: 2022
- Completion: 2026
- Website: https://hillcrestdehradun.com

## Location

- Near Pacific Golf Estate, Sahastradhara Road
- 10 km from Dehradun city centre
- 25 km from Mussoorie
- Nearby schools: DPS Dehradun, Khrist Jyoti Academy, Shri Guru Ram Rai Public School
- Nearby hospitals: Fortis Escorts Hospital, Max Super Speciality Hospital, Himalayan Hospital (SRHU)

## Features

- Panoramic Shivalik mountain views (360-degree)
- Italian marble flooring
- Natural stone fireplace
- Designer interiors
- Private lawn and balcony
- Landscaped gardens and walking paths
- 24/7 security with CCTV
- Low-density: only 15 villas for maximum privacy

## What's Next

Urban Estates is launching a new MDDA approved plotting project in Dehradun.
Contact for early access and priority updates.

## FAQ

Q: What is the starting price of villas at Hillcrest Dehradun?
A: Villas at Hillcrest Dehradun start from ₹5.5 crore.

Q: How many villas are part of the Hillcrest project?
A: Hillcrest is an exclusive development comprising only 15 luxury villas.

Q: Are there any villas available for sale?
A: All villas at Hillcrest are sold out. Urban Estates is launching a new MDDA approved plotting project in Dehradun.

Q: Is Hillcrest Dehradun MDDA approved?
A: Yes, Hillcrest is fully MDDA approved and authorised as a gated society.

Q: What is the configuration of Hillcrest villas?
A: Each villa is a premium 4 BHK + Study Room, fully furnished with Italian marble floors, natural stone fireplace, designer interiors, private lawn, balcony, and mountain views.

Q: Who is the developer?
A: Urban Estates, a luxury real estate developer based in Dehradun, Uttarakhand.

Q: When was the project launched?
A: Established in 2022, with completion and possession expected in 2026.

Q: Is Hillcrest a good investment?
A: Its limited inventory of 15 villas, luxury positioning, and Dehradun's growing demand for premium residential developments make it attractive for both end-users and investors.

Q: What makes Hillcrest different from other villa projects in Dehradun?
A: Low-density luxury living with only 15 villas, ensuring greater privacy and exclusivity. Located near Sahastradhara with panoramic Shivalik mountain views.
